title: Bridge construction
goal: Show a coherent bridge-construction precedence network from notice to opening.

rubric.must: Excavate Foundations visibly waits for both Survey and Setting Out and Environmental Controls.
Erect Girders visibly waits for both piers and abutments and fabricated girders.
A visible chain runs from girder erection through deck, barriers and drainage, paving, load test, and opening.
Fabricate Girders visibly begins independently after Notice to Proceed while foundation work proceeds.
Notice to Proceed and Open to Traffic are visibly distinguished as milestones.
The critical path is visibly highlighted along the controlling construction sequence.
